content.title: The HYdroclimate Drought and Rainfall Atlas (HYDRA): A global atlas of hydroclimate variability linked to large-scale ocean-atmosphere climate modes
content.abstract: Global and regional hydroclimate variability is strongly modulated by large-scale ocean-atmosphere modes with variability on interannual to multidecadal timescales. Assessments of how these modes influence terrestrial hydroclimate, such as soil moisture, precipitation, and temperature, remain scattered across studies that differ in their employed datasets, the climate index definitions that quantify the modal states and the temporal periods chosen for analysis and defined climatologies.
